title: DNS-over-HTTPS: disable automatic DoH resolution
description: Sets the documented EnableAutoDoh value of the DNS Cache service parameters to 2, which stops the service from automatically resolving names over DNS-over-HTTPS against known template servers. Predictable plain DNS is what the network.dns profiles rely on: without this, Windows may bypass the explicitly configured resolvers. The previous value is captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo (catalog 86); the newer DoHPolicy group policy is a separate value and is not touched.
